description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows) to grab the frontmost window and attach it to the current chat.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl 捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话。
